caption: The drawing depicts an enclosed garden area next to a long, single-story building with a reddish-brown, gabled roof and pale beige or cream walls. The building has several doors and windows facing the garden, and a small annex or entrance with a similarly colored roof at one corner. The garden area is divided into separate rectangular sections by green hedges or low bushes. One section contains a central square flower bed with a circular blue feature, possibly a fountain, surrounded by symmetrical floral patterns in red, yellow, and green. Other sections include two rectangular garden beds with green and brown rows, likely representing planted vegetables or crops, and one rectangular grassed area with regularly spaced green circles indicating small shrubs or trees. In the far end of the garden, there are two dense, tall trees and a border of various shrubs and flowering plants. Along the garden's boundary, there are continuous lines of closely planted trees or bushes forming a green border. The overall composition is geometric and symmetrical, with a muted color palette dominated by greens, browns, blues, and soft reds. The background is a plain, light tan or beige color.
title: Block Plan
